component.name: Tiles
component.summary: The classic 2048 puzzle for Linux desktops

description.p: Tiles is the classic 2048 puzzle as a native Linux desktop app, built with Rust, GTK4 and libadwaita. Slide tiles with the keyboard, mouse or touch to merge equal numbers and reach the 2048 tile.
It ships animated slides and merge pops, Light, Sepia and Dark color modes, a GNOME-style About window, on-screen controls and a persisted best score.
First release under the Tiles name: new branding and app icon, Debian, Fedora, Arch and Flatpak packaging.
